text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — high 5xx rate on model-redwood-v4 (canary). 5xxs -> 12% in 3m, threshold=2%. Link: https://alerts.internal/alert/75321

oncall-jen: I'm on it, paging @sre-miguel and @ml-deepa.

sre-miguel: pulling logs now, will report back. Can we mute canary traffic while we triage?

deploy-bot: Canary routing controlled by rollout flags. API: curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flags/canary_traffic -d 'percent=0'

oncall-jen: Hold on muting until we confirm impact. @ml-deepa can you verify artifact / tokenizer versions for the canary?

ml-deepa: Checking. Canary weight hash = f2a9c4...; serving config shows tokenizer v2.0 but artifact manifest claims tokenizer v2.1. Suspect config drift during promotion.

support-luis: Customer impact: several low-latency customers see garbled outputs and timeouts, some UI errors. No PII exfiltration reported.

sre-miguel: Logs show repeated: `ERROR Tokenizer: unknown token id 50213` followed by postproc failures and 502s. Traces point to mismatch between token mapping and weights.

oncall-jen: Action plan: pause canary traffic and flip rollout kill-switch for the model rollout. Miguel, can you execute?

sre-miguel: Executing now: `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flags/canary_traffic -d 'percent=0' && curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flags/model_rollout_kill -d 'on=true'`

deploy-bot: Done — canary traffic set to 0%. model_rollout_kill=true :white_check_mark:

ml-deepa: Confirmed live instances now serve tokenizer v2.0, but weight files on disk appear to be the v2.1-trained bundle (f2a9c4...). We should rollback weights to stable hash a3b7d9... and restart workers.

oncall-jen: Miguel coordinate rollback with deploy. We'll do a controlled rollback and restart.

sre-miguel: Initiating rollback: `deploy rollback --service=inference --model=model-redwood-v4 --weights=a3b7d9... --restart-workers --graceful`

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued (rb-75321). Per-node ETA ~90s.

support-luis: I'll prepare the customer notification draft and flag affected accounts in the CS queue.

product-elaine: Quick note — after rollback we should flush model prefix caches to avoid stale KV/embeddings causing more errors.

ml-deepa: Agreed. After rollback completes I'll trigger cache flush: `POST /cache/flush?prefix=model-redwood-v4`

sre-miguel: Rollback progress: 80% nodes updated, remaining nodes restarting. Metrics: 5xx dropping already to ~0.8%.

deploy-bot: rb-75321 complete. All nodes now at weights a3b7d9... and tokenizer v2.0.

oncall-jen: Deepa, please run the cache flush. I'll monitor traces and SLOs.

ml-deepa: Cache flush triggered. Sampling outputs look correct; tokenizer errors gone in last 5m.

support-luis: Customer notices queued and sent. Marking incident P2, no escalations so far.

oncall-jen: Post-incident action items: 1) Add a rollout preflight check to verify tokenizer tag matches weight manifest. Owner: ml-deepa. 2) Add CI gate to prevent weight promotion without tokenizer sync. Owner: ci-team. 3) Add canary auto-kill at 2% 5xx with direct routing to ML oncall. Owner: infra-alerting.

product-elaine: Also propose adding a checksum check in the deploy pipeline and a lightweight inference sanity test post-promotion.

oncall-jen: Closing pager — if anything reappears ping #oncall. Great job everyone :tada:
